name: Community Workshop Registration Site
promise: Produce an accessible community workshop registration website with a clear schedule, trustworthy event details, and a tested registration path.
summary: A fictional third-party Outcome Pack used only to verify federated catalog ingestion and discovery. It turns confirmed workshop information into a small public website and checks that a visitor can understand the event and complete registration.
useWhen: A community organizer needs a public workshop registration website rather than a general-purpose application.
The schedule, venue, capacity, accessibility notes, and registration destination can be confirmed before publication.
notFor: A native mobile application or app store release.
Publishing unconfirmed claims or collecting personal data without approval.

skills.name: Community Web
skills.role: Build and review a small accessible event website

workstreams.name: Workshop registration site
workstreams.brief: Confirm the supplied workshop facts, build the smallest responsive website that explains the event, connect only the approved registration destination, and test the complete visitor path.

guardrails: Do not invent dates, venue details, capacity, accessibility claims, or organizer contact information.
Do not publish or collect personal data without separate approval.
verification: A fresh visitor can identify the workshop, schedule, venue, accessibility notes, and registration action.
Keyboard navigation, responsive layout, and the approved registration destination are tested.

expectations.statement: Every public event detail is traceable to confirmed organizer-provided information.
A visitor can understand the workshop and reach the approved registration destination using keyboard or touch navigation.
